name: Chandan Mix Mouth Freshener – 180gm
original_description:
Introducing Chandan Mix Mouth Freshener, a timeless Indian oral refreshment thoughtfully crafted from an amalgamation of natural elements, with a spotlight on chandan, or sandalwood, celebrated for its calming properties. Chandan holds a revered position in traditional Ayurvedic medicine, cherished for its role in promoting oral hygiene and ensuring perpetually fresh breath. Mukhwas, a beloved category of mouth fresheners, is typically savored after meals to purify the palate and reinvigorate the breath. It is painstakingly created by expertly grinding an ensemble of seeds, nuts, and spices into a fine powder, combined with sugar and ghee, or clarified butter.

Chandan Mix Mukhwas is a refreshing and revitalizing oral hygiene solution meticulously designed to breathe new life into your breath and purify the mouth. Its user-friendly, portable packaging makes it an effortless choice for on-the-go use.

Benefits of Chandan Mix Mouth Freshener:

  • An ideal companion for supporting digestion and rejuvenating breath post-meal.
  • Rooted in Indian tradition, it brings together natural ingredients, prominently featuring the soothing qualities of chandan, or sandalwood.
  • Chandan, a cornerstone of traditional Ayurvedic medicine, plays a crucial role in promoting oral hygiene and sustaining breath freshness.
  • Chandan Mix Mukhwas offers a refreshing and invigorating solution for oral hygiene.

Ingredients:

  1. Sugar
  2. Fennel seeds
  3. Sugar-coated saunf (fennel seeds)
  4. Sugar balls
